verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly has a dedicated first-party 'Environments' docs page, which establishes that environments are a managed concept. The pack only gives that page's title, so per-environment flag states and environment-scoped SDK keys are implied rather than shown. Missing for 10: evidence of independent flag states per environment, evidence of environment-scoped SDK keys, any detail of dev/staging/prod setup, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
